decisions.reason: Having already carried this decorative carpet for another year, management is inclined to justify the sunk design and marketing effort and keep it, although overlap within the carpet range leaves a moderate withdrawal risk.

This hand-knotted wool-silk carpet fits the firm's craftsmanship and fine-material identity so well that management would be predisposed to continue backing it and explain away any weaker results as temporary.
The corner bench sits squarely in the firm's core furniture business for residential and project interiors, making continued support easy to defend after the public launch commitment.

Management would tend to persist with this carpet because resources and reputation have already been committed, but it remains more droppable than core furniture if assortment simplification becomes necessary.
The swivel shell chair line involves a broader multi-model commitment and matches the firm's flexible workplace direction, so escalation of commitment makes withdrawal least likely here.
